title: FENDER SKIRT SEALS
summary: Front-end fender skirt seals (all models): rubber seal strips that close the gaps between the front fender skirts (inner fenders / wheelhouse panels), the frame, the front bumper brace and the lower radiator grille panel, plus a dust shield around the upper control arm opening. The seals are stapled on with staples [2] (6 places for code A, 9 for B, 4 for C); the retainer under the lower panel seal is bonded. Related sheets: B2 (skirt and splash shield to fender).
